primary_sources.title: Neumann--Raymond, Seifert manifolds, plumbing, mu-invariant and orientation reversing maps, LNM664(1978),163-196
primary_sources.used_statement: Theorem1.2 Euler naturality for oriented fibre-preserving maps, including branched maps; signed inverse slice convention and Euler definition; Theorem5.1 star plumbing and signed continued fractions, intersection form, and Theorem5.2 Schur/definiteness convention. Convert the paper signed leg parameter to minus the positive beta in a normalized negative leg. The proof derives the model, Euler number, selected inverse entry and mod3 mismatch; no contact/filling classification or full satellite plumbing theorem imported.

primary_sources.title: Hillman--Sakuma, On the homology of finite abelian coverings of links, Canadian Mathematical Bulletin40(1997),309-315
primary_sources.used_statement: For knots the cyclic exterior homology splits integrally as the branched-cover homology plus Z; the page also warns that equal Alexander polynomials do not determine homology-group structure in general. PF65 reproves the integral split with explicit peripheral maps and computes the full torus Alexander module, not only its order.

primary_sources.title: Dubouloz--Kishimoto, A1-fibrations on affine threefolds, arXiv1212.0521v1
primary_sources.used_statement: Independent corroboration that cylinder projections extend on smooth affine surfaces; cylinder alone does not give a Ga action. PF90 proves the stronger actual-coordinate and whole-fibre claims directly.

primary_sources.title: Cahn--Catania--Chimgee--Del Guercio--Kendrick, Dihedral linking invariants, arXiv2112.14790v2
sections: 6.1 complete trefoil example and linear systems
primary_sources.used_statement: Worked trefoil mutual index1/index2 linking value2 and its displayed two chain systems; compared to an independent unfilled CW computation. Chosen diagonal push-off framing is not identified with our preferred longitude.

primary_sources.title: Ni--Wu, Heegaard Floer correction terms and rational genus bounds, arXiv1205.7053v2
sections: 5.1 Proposition5.1 with complete proof and proof of Theorem1.2
primary_sources.used_statement: For an integrally null-homologous Floer-simple knot in an L-space, Proposition5.1 gives zero correction-term difference and genus0. Together with the interior-core criterion this obstructs an incompressible exterior meridian from the L-space interior.

primary_sources.title: Rasmussen--Rasmussen, Floer simple manifolds and L-space intervals, arXiv1508.05900v2
sections: 3.1 Lemmas3.2-3.5, complete proofs and following mirror/interior argument
primary_sources.used_statement: A filling slope in the L-space interior has Floer-simple filling core: another L-space filling gives coherent chains; a non-simple coherent chain forces that slope to an endpoint. No gluing conjecture from this version is imported; the graph gluing theorem is the retained published1511.04413 Corollary6.1.

primary_sources.title: Ozsvath--Szabo, Knot Floer homology and rational surgeries, arXivmath/0504404v1
